'''''Star Wars: Doctor Aphra''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series that began publication on [[December 7]], [[2016]].<ref name="firstissue" /> It was originally written by [[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2015)|''Star Wars: Darth Vader'']] scribe [[Kieron Gillen]]. It was then briefly co-written by him and [[Simon Spurrier]] before writing duties were transferred fully to Spurrier after [[Star Wars: Doctor Aphra Book IV: Remastered|''Remastered'']]. The series was first teased on [[September 19]], 2016,<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/31099-another-star-wars-ongoing-by-gillen-walker.html|text=Marvel Launches New STAR WARS Ongoing in December|author=Arrant, Chris|date=2016-09-16|work=Newsarama|archivedate=20160920122708}}</ref> before being officially announced on [[October 12]], 2016.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://screenrant.com/star-wars-comics-classified-doctor-aphra-ongoing|text=Marvel's ''Star Wars: Classified'' Revealed as New ''Doctor Aphra'' Series|author=Kubai, Andy|date=2016-10-12|work=[https://screenrant.com ScreenRant]|archivedate=20200730052410}}</ref>

The series takes place between [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]'' ''— mainly on the [[Outer Rim Territories|galactic frontier]]—and follows from the conclusion of ''Star Wars: Darth Vader''. It focuses on the titular character, "rogue [[archaeologist]]" [[Doctor]] [[Chelli Lona Aphra]], her [[droid]] duo, the "murderbots" [[0-0-0|Triple-Zero]] and [[BT-1|Beetee-One]], [[Wookiee]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Krrsantan]], and [[Vulaada Klam]], Aphra's side-kick later in the series.

Designed to be the moral inverse of [[Wikipedia:Indiana Jones|Indiana Jones]], the misadventures of her and her eponymous [[Aphra's crew|crew]] are a dark reflection of the adventures of the [[Star Wars (2015)|''Star Wars'' (2015)]] [[Heroes of Yavin|heroes]].

The current run concluded in its [[Doctor Aphra (2016) 40|fortieth issue]] on [[December 11]], 2019. A relaunch began in April [[2020]] [[Star Wars: Doctor Aphra (2020)|under the same title]]—written by Alyssa Wong and with art by Marika Cresta—the events of that series continue Aphra's story between ''Star Wars: ''Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back ''and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars: ''Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'''']].<ref name="Announcement">{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/47583-star-wars-doctor-aphra.html|text=STAR WARS: DOCTOR APHRA Relaunching in 2020|author=Marston, George|date=10/25/2019|work=Newsarama.com|archivedate=20191027041011}}</ref>''
